description: Migrate 10 active source files off the deprecated src/analyzer/graph-builder.ts to src/pipeline/graph-builder.ts. The two schemas are structurally incompatible (Map-based vs ExportedGraph), so each consumer (graph-to-elements.ts, chunk-converter.ts, indexing-orchestrator.ts, ai-prompt-generator.ts, and 6 others) must be individually adapted before the legacy module can be deleted.
